requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection (Annex 5, para. 3.3) of the retro-reflector illuminating surface from an observation distance of 10 m; pass if its shape cannot easily be confused with the equilateral triangle shape of Class IIIA/IIIB retro-reflectors (para. 2.1).

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 1 heat resistance test: condition the retro-reflector sample in a dry atmosphere oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 consecutive hours; verify the conditioning duration and temperature are recorded within tolerance.

requirements.text: After the heat resistance test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visual examination after completion of the Annex 6 Part 1 heat resistance test procedure; pass if no cracking and no appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device or its optical component is visible.

requirements.text: After the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: After the Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1 sequence, inspect visually. Pass: no water on the reflecting surface.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after immersion. Any clearly visible water at the reflecting surface means fail.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF during the water spray test.
requirements.test_case: Energise lamp functions at design voltage with 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle during spray; check cycle log.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation and no standing pool of water shall be formed, or be able to be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of interior after drain; tap and tilt device; pass if no standing pool of water forms.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Corrosion test per Annex 6 Part 4 (ISO 9227:2017 saline mist); verify photometric (RA) and colorimetric characteristics remain within prescribed limits after test.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Remove all removable parts; expose to saline mist 24 h, dry 2 h, expose 24 h (total 50 h); record compliance with test sequence.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Verify salt spray chamber at 35 °C ± 2 °C using 5 % NaCl solution in distilled water with ≤ 0.02 % impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection immediately after 50 h saline mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion liable to impair device efficiency.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 value and ≤ Table 10 value.

requirements.text: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1: TM1 (Black-standard thermometer, cycle No. 1) of 102 min dry at 60 ± 2 W/m² broadband (300 to 400 nm) / 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² narrowband (340 nm), 65 ± 3 °C black-standard temperature and 50 ± 10 % relative humidity, followed by 18 min water spray at 60 ± 2 W/m² / 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m²; or TM2 (Black-panel thermometer, cycle No. 4) with the same parameters at 63 ± 3 °C black-panel temperature.
requirements.test_case: Run the Xenon-arc exposure per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using either TM1 or TM2 cycle parameters from Table A6-1, and record which method was used. Pass: irradiance, temperature, humidity and spray cycle are held within the stated tolerances under equilibrium conditions.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Expose retro-reflector samples per Table A6-1. Pass: the total exposure duration is 500 hours.

requirements.text: For the resistance to fuels test of a retro-reflective device, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1: Prepare the test mixture of 70 vol. % n-heptane and 30 vol. % toluol. Check the mixture composition against the test record. Pass if the specified mixture is used.

requirements.text: After about five minutes, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1.1(b): Inspect the wiped surface visually about 5 minutes after wiping. Pass if there are no apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are acceptable.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation on vehicle and perform vibration exposure representative of normal conditions of use (paras 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1., 2.3.10.2.); afterwards re-verify photometric, colour and geometric visibility/position characteristics; pass if all remain within the prescribed values of the Regulation.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect mounting design and attempt to shift lamp orientation under normal handling/service (e.g. tailgate operation, cleaning, vibration); pass if lamp aim/position cannot change unintentionally without deliberate use of tools.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle on a flat horizontal surface, measure the angle between the reference axis of each fitted lamp function and the bearing plane; pass if parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, when fitted to the vehicle, shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle in plan view between the reference axis of each fitted lamp function and the vehicle median longitudinal plane; pass if parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: For the orientation of the reference axis of light-signalling devices when fitted to the vehicle, a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Verify measured deviations of the reference axis from the prescribed orientation, vertically and horizontally; pass if each deviation is no more than 3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the light-signalling device laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp against the manufacturer's fitting instructions (mounting, orientation, fastening); pass if all instructions are met.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure the left and right lamp positions relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane, using the exterior geometrical form of the housing and lens on vehicle or CAD. Pass if the positions are mirror-symmetric about the plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the external geometry of the LH and RH lamps (CAD mirror check or visual inspection), ignoring the interior structure. Pass if the external forms are mirror images about the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of each function on the LH and RH lamps per the applicable device regulation colorimetric method. Pass if both lamps of each pair meet the same colour requirement (red for rear position, stop and retro-reflector; white for reversing).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Perform goniophotometric measurement of each function on the LH and RH lamps at the prescribed test points. Pass if the light distributions are substantially identical, unless the pair is approved as a matched pair.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle and only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear (and front) for lamps incorporating logos. Pass if there are at most two lateral logos (one per side) or one central logo on each end.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any logo incorporated in the lamp. Pass if every logo is a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements (paragraphs 5.1 to 5.5 of UN R48, including symmetrical installation of paired lamps) shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection per UN R48: on a vehicle with asymmetrical external shape, verify the lamp positions, symmetry and geometric visibility requirements of the preceding paragraphs are met as far as the body shape allows; deviations shall be justified by the asymmetry only.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Design review and installation inspection on the vehicle: verify each grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated function separately meets its colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements of UN R48. Pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Photometric and colorimetric measurement of each function with all other functions of the rear combination lamp switched OFF. Pass if each function meets its prescribed intensity and colour limits.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of each reciprocally incorporated function (e.g. stop lamp) with that function and the rear position lamp switched ON together. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates stay within the prescribed colour boundaries.

requirements.text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the lamp: check that the stop lamp does not share a light source or illuminating surface with any direction-indicator lamp. Pass if no reciprocal incorporation exists.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: CAD/geometric measurement of the apparent surface projection in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the outer lens. Pass if projected area ≥ 60 % of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the minimum distance between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts ≤ 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Apply the geometric verification of paragraph 5.7.2.1 (≥ 60 % quadrilateral occupation or ≤ 75 mm gap between facing edges). Pass if either criterion is met.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system; however, a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Design and approval documentation review: verify lamps sharing the housing or common outer lens are not declared/approved as an interdependent lamp system unless band- or strip-shaped. Pass if classification is consistent.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Functional and photometric check: switch each function ON at nominal voltage and monitor luminous intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period (e.g. goniophotometer/photometer recording, colorimeter, visual inspection). Pass if no intentional variation (no dimming patterns, flashing, colour change or change of illuminated area) occurs while the function is ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary (a) in relation to the ambient light, (b) as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or (c) when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: For each implemented variation mode (ambient-light dependent, other lamps ON/OFF, e.g. stop lamp with rear position lamp ON, or other function use), measure photometric characteristics (intensity at grid points, colour) per the applicable device regulation in every state. Pass if all states meet the technical provisions for the lamp concerned (e.g. min/max intensities, colour, intensity ratios); if no variation is implemented, verify by design review.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation check per paragraph 5.10.4.1 (Annex 4, Zone 1, 25 m in front of vehicle); pass if no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observer moving within Zone 1 of Annex 4 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if the apparent surface of the red lamp is not directly visible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, except while one or more of the following conditions exist (paragraph 5.11.1): (a) front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level inspection and functional check of the lighting circuit: operate the position lamp switch and verify that the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF only together with the front position lamps, end-outline marker lamps (if any), side-marker lamps (if any) and rear registration plate lamp. Check that independent switching occurs only under exceptions (a) to (d). Pass if no other independent switching is possible.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the emitted light with the reversing lamp energised; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the white boundaries defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the emitted light with the stop lamp energised; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the red boundaries defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the emitted light with the rear position lamp energised; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the red boundaries defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light reflected by the non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the reflected light under the standard illuminant; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the red boundaries defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the vehicle installation: count the installed rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors and compare them against the numbers specified in the individual specifications of UN R48 (paragraph 6). Pass if each count equals the prescribed number.

requirements.text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Installation review on the vehicle: identify whether any lamp function is fitted on a movable component (e.g. tailgate). If so, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. Pass if all conditions of those paragraphs are fulfilled, or if no lamp is installed on a movable component.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection on vehicle: with the movable component in each fixed position (closed and every fixed open position), verify position, geometric visibility, colour and photometric values of the rear position lamp and retro-reflector; pass if all requirements are met in every position.

requirements.text: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.test_case: Check lamp marking "D"; with the movable component in each fixed position, verify that at least one of the two lamps meets position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements; pass if satisfied in all positions.

requirements.text: Where additional lamps for the rear position lamp, rear direction-indicator and rear retro-reflector functions are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Open the movable component to each fixed open position; verify the additional lamps are switched ON and meet position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps on the movable component; pass if all met.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection per UN R48: place the movable component (e.g. tailgate open) in each position other than the normal position of use, operate the lamp functions and verify by visual assessment that no glare or undue discomfort is caused to road users; pass if no undue discomfort is observed.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp fitted on the movable component (e.g. tailgate), open and close the movable component repeatedly to its normal position(s) of use; after each cycle, measure the lamp position and orientation relative to the vehicle. Pass: the lamp returns each time to the manufacturer-specified position(s), and installation and geometric visibility requirements are still met in that position.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection: place each movable component carrying or near the lamp in every manufacturer-specified fixed (rest) position other than normal position of use; measure the visible fraction of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; pass if no more than 50 per cent is hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Move the movable component to each fixed position where more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface is hidden; verify additional lamps switch ON automatically and that they comply with position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements of the replaced lamps.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the lamp shall therefore be capable of being made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection on vehicle: with the lamp installed and connected to the vehicle wiring, verify that each function (rear position, stop, reversing) operates when activated without any action other than fitting a light source and/or fuse; pass if all functions operate, otherwise the lamp is deemed not present.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp function (e.g. disconnect LED string); verify by photometric and colorimetric measurement and inspection that the replacement function's colour, main intensity and position are similar to the failed rear position lamp function.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: With the rear position lamp function failed and replacement active, operate the replacement device's original function (e.g. apply brake); verify that it still performs its original safety function and complies with its photometric requirements.

requirements.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level test: induce rear position lamp failure triggering replacement; verify that the dashboard tell-tale activates and indicates the temporary replacement and need for repair throughout the replacement.

requirements.text: If rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, the intensity of all these lamps shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of each function across the variable intensity range. Pass if all functions vary simultaneously, in the same direction and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: For rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions in the entire intensity range.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensities of the rear position lamp and stop lamp simultaneously during intensity transitions over the full range. Pass if the prescribed stop/position intensity ratio is maintained at all points.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. shall comply with the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. to 5.27.3. when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant; the applicant shall demonstrate this to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level demonstration: operate the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the M1 category as specified by the applicant. Measure the voltage at the rear combination lamp terminals for each function. Pass if the provisions of 5.27.1 to 5.27.3 are met.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle in a constant voltage operating condition, measure the voltage at the lamp terminals for each function. Pass if the voltage is ≤ the voltage stated in the lamp's type approval documentation. Not applicable if the exemption in 5.27.3 applies.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent. The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle in a constant voltage operating condition, measure the voltage at the device terminals. Pass if the voltage is ≤ 6.95 V (6 V system), ≤ 13.905 V (12 V system) or ≤ 28.84 V (24 V system). Not applicable if the exemption in 5.27.3 applies.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the lamp's electronics and type approval documentation. Determine whether the device includes an electronic light source control gear, an integrated variable intensity control, or only UN R128-approved light sources. If so, the voltage limits of 5.27.1 and 5.27.2 do not apply; otherwise verify them per 5.27.1 or 5.27.2.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Installation check / CAD visibility analysis: observe apparent surface from infinity across the required angles of geometric visibility for each function; pass if no vehicle part obstructs light propagation, except obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the installed lamp with masking replicating the hidden areas; pass if the unobstructed part meets the photometric values of the device approval regulation.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per para. 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify photometric field of measurement of the installed unit down to at least 5° below horizontal meets requirements.

requirements.text: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Document review: check the component type approval communication sheet of the lamp. If the LED module is non-replaceable, pass only if the sheet states that it is non-replaceable. If no such statement exists, verify by inspection that the LED module is replaceable.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Document review: check for a valid type approval under the corresponding device Regulation (e.g. UN R148 for rear position, stop and reversing lamps; UN R150 for the retro-reflector) for each function. Check the approval markings on the lamp. Pass if every installed function is covered by a valid approval.

requirements.text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp design for an incorporated manufacturer logo. If a logo is present, check for a UN R148 type approval covering the lamp with the logo and the corresponding approval marking. Pass if a valid UN R148 approval exists.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify that at least one reversing lamp is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: One reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count reversing lamp devices on the M1 vehicle; pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify the lamp carries a valid UN R23 (00 or later series) or UN R148 (00 or later series) approval mark for the reversing function; pass if approval is present and valid.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the unladen vehicle on substantially horizontal ground the height of the illuminating surface edges of the reversing lamp; pass if lowest point ≥ 250 mm and highest point ≤ 1,200 mm above ground.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the reversing lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle; pass if rear-mounted.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle per paragraph 2.10.7: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over α = +15°/−5° and β = ±45° (one device) or 45° outwards/30° inwards (two devices); pass if visibility ensured over the whole field.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional vehicle test: engage reverse gear with propulsion system operable; pass if lamp switches ON only under both conditions.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional vehicle test: with lamp ON, disengage reverse gear, then separately switch propulsion system off; also attempt activation with each condition unmet; pass if lamp is OFF in all cases.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation; otherwise the tell-tale is optional.
requirements.test_case: Check component regulation (UN R23/R148) for failure tell-tale requirement; if required, simulate LED failure and verify tell-tale activates; pass if tell-tale indicates failure.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify presence of S1 or S2 category stop lamps on the vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of stop lamps shall be two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count installed stop lamp devices by category; pass if two S1/S2 devices and one S3/S4 device are fitted.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify approval mark and certificate under UN R7 02 series or later, or UN R148 00 series or later; pass if valid approval present.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface in the reference axis direction to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure on unladen vehicle per para. 5.8.1 the height of the apparent surface above ground; pass if 350 mm ≤ height ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justification applies and no optional lamps).

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the position in length shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: pass if the stop lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; however, for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle/CAD: verify unobstructed apparent surface over 45° outward and 45° inward (or 20° inward below H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visibility achieved.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the vertical angle of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle/CAD: verify unobstructed apparent surface 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visibility achieved.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: pass if the reference axis of the stop lamp points rearward.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: apply brake signal per UN R13/R13-H; pass if all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: A tell-tale for the stop lamp is optional; however, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component regulation (UN R7/R148) approval for failure-indication requirement; if required, simulate LED failure and pass if failure tell-tale is activated.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the rear position lamp function is fitted and its approval marking shows category R, R1 or R2; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection and approval document check: count the rear position lamps and check approval markings and certificates; pass if exactly two lamps are fitted, each approved to UN R7 02+ or UN R148 00+.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. This condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle, along the reference axis, the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground with the vehicle on a horizontal surface according to paragraph 5.8.1; pass if lowest edge ≥ 350 mm and highest edge ≤ 1,500 mm (≤ 2,100 mm only where bodywork justifies it and no optional lamps are fitted).

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if the rear position lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: verify an unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° inwards (20° under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm) and 80° outwards; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: verify an unobstructed view of the apparent surface 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (5° downward if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane; and a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: If this alternative is chosen, confirm a rear side-marker lamp is fitted, then check unobstructed visibility of the apparent surface over 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under H plane if below 750 mm) and 15° up/down (5° down if below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres; the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.test_case: At each limit direction of the geometric visibility angles, measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface excluding non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear position lamp shall be rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reference axis of the rear position lamp points rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Functional check on vehicle per paragraph 5.11: verify the rear position lamps switch ON/OFF together with the front position lamps and registration plate lamp; pass if compliant.

requirements.text: Rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify presence of non-triangular rear retro-reflectors on the M1 vehicle; pass if fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle has two retro-reflectors bearing valid R3 (02 series or later) Class IA/IB or R150 (00 series or later) approval markings; pass if both approved.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Visual/photometric review of installation: pass if any additional retro-reflecting devices do not obscure or impair mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral distance from outermost point of illuminating surface to extreme outer edge of vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes has no special requirement.
requirements.test_case: Documentation check: no minimum separation verification required for M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of illuminating surface above ground on unladen vehicle per para 5.8; pass if ≥ 250 mm and ≤ 900 mm (≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with rear lamps, ≤ 1,500 mm if bodywork justification applies).

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be: horizontal angle 30° inwards and outwards; vertical angle 10° above and below horizontal; however, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check (CAD/vehicle): verify unobstructed illuminating surface over ±30° horizontal and +10°/−10° vertical (−5° downward if mounted below 750 mm); pass if no obstruction.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation: pass if reference axis points rearwards parallel to the vehicle longitudinal axis.

requirements.text: The values measured for the distances of the lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured width/height/length distances with the individual installation specifications for rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector; pass if all are within limits.

requirements.text: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation, and the values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: COP check per paragraph 2.10.7.: measure horizontal and vertical visibility angles of each installed lamp; pass if the individual specified angles are met, allowing ±3º tolerance on angle limits.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings, and these shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of installed lamps and markings: verify presence, number, colour (red/white), arrangement and category; pass if paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and individual lamp specifications are fulfilled.
